statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-6879 is quadratic-time behavior in xml.etree.ElementTree XPath index predicates. No fixed version is available yet for the HSP python-3.13 3.13.14-3 package; upstream indicates a fix landing in CPython 3.15.0. Tracking for a stable 3.13.x DHI package rebuild or backport.

CVE-2026-6879 is quadratic-time behavior in xml.etree.ElementTree XPath index predicates. No fixed version is available yet for the HSP python-3.13 3.13.14-3 package; upstream indicates a fix landing in CPython 3.15.0. Tracking for a stable 3.13.x DHI package rebuild or backport.

CVE-2026-4360 is a tarfile.extract() hardlink filter/ownership issue in CPython. Scout reports a fix only in CPython 3.15.0-beta4, which is a major upgrade from HSP python-3.13 3.13.14-3. Tracking for a stable 3.13.x DHI package rebuild that backports the fix.

CVE-2026-15308 is a CPU denial-of-service in CPython html.parser.HTMLParser via repeated unterminated markup declarations. Scout reports a fix only in CPython 3.15.0-beta4, which is a major upgrade from the HSP python-3.13 3.13.14-3 package used for cqlsh/yq on debian-13 1.28/1.29 tracks. Tracking for a stable 3.13.x DHI package rebuild that backports the fix rather than jumping to 3.15 beta.
